events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, the legendary Woodstock Festival of Music & Art kicked off in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Three days of peace, love, and music. What's your top track from the iconic Woodstock Festival?

events.title: Elvis Presley Tribute
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, who would have been 91.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: It's 49 years since we lost the King, Elvis Presley. His music lives on. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur Tribute
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the tragic passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, a voice that defined a generation, who would have been 55 today. His impact on music is undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi's Genius
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, a true guitar icon, on the anniversary of his passing. His music continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Magic
angles.copy: 47 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure genius. What's your favourite from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: LG's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless solo album 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine 51 Years
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates globally. What does it mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple unveiled the original iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years since it dropped and changed everything. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic film franchise, marking the release date of the first film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonder
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped the 'White Album'. So many classics, so much experimentation. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: We remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury on the anniversary of his passing. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.
